mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may be potentiated by estradiol through altered hepatic metabolism and increased anticholinergic side effects, while estradiol may have reduced efficacy due to benztropine's effects on GI motility and absorption.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic symptoms (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and consider dose adjustments if excessive anticholinergic effects occur; assess for breakthrough psychiatric symptoms if estradiol efficacy diminishes.
